title: Supplier Alpha — Industrial Gateway Specification
content: Supplier Alpha offers the AX-400 industrial edge gateway. Operating temperature is -20°C to +60°C. Ingress protection is IP54. Typical power draw is 18 W. Connectivity includes dual Gigabit Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6, and optional 5G. The device supports TPM 2.0, secure boot, signed firmware, and a five-year security update commitment. Standard lead time is 8 weeks. Unit price for 500 units is EUR 438. Warranty is 36 months. Alpha states that 72% of final assembly electricity is sourced from renewable energy.

title: Supplier Beta — Industrial Gateway Specification
content: Supplier Beta offers the BG-550 rugged industrial gateway. Operating temperature is -30°C to +70°C. Ingress protection is IP67. Typical power draw is 24 W. Connectivity includes dual Gigabit Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6E, and integrated 5G. Security capabilities include TPM 2.0, secure boot, signed firmware, remote attestation, and a seven-year security update commitment. Standard lead time is 12 weeks. Unit price for 500 units is EUR 486. Warranty is 60 months. Beta reports 48% renewable electricity in final assembly.

title: Engineering & Procurement Requirements — Edge Gateway 2026
content: The target industrial gateway must operate from at least -20°C to +60°C, provide at least IP54 protection, include dual Ethernet, support hardware-backed key storage and secure boot, and commit to at least five years of security updates. Target unit cost is below EUR 470 at 500 units. Preferred lead time is ten weeks or less. Warranty must be at least 36 months. For high-exposure sites, remote attestation is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Supplier Cybersecurity Evidence Policy
content: Suppliers of connected industrial products must provide evidence for vulnerability disclosure, secure update mechanisms, security update duration, software component inventory, and incident communication. For critical deployments, security review requires a threat model and an SBOM in CycloneDX or SPDX format before production release. Remote attestation is recommended for high-exposure systems.

title: Sustainable Procurement Guideline
content: For comparable suppliers, procurement should consider energy efficiency, warranty duration, renewable electricity share in final assembly, logistics distance, repairability, and evidence quality. Sustainability factors inform the decision but do not override mandatory technical or cybersecurity requirements.

title: Supplier Alpha — Commercial Terms
content: Payment terms are net 45 days. Price for 500 AX-400 units is EUR 438 per unit, excluding freight. Minimum order quantity is 100 units. Expedited delivery can reduce lead time from 8 weeks to 6 weeks at a 4% surcharge. Warranty is 36 months. Volume rebate of 2% applies above 1,000 units.

title: Supplier Beta — Commercial Terms
content: Payment terms are net 30 days. Price for 500 BG-550 units is EUR 486 per unit, excluding freight. Minimum order quantity is 250 units. Standard lead time is 12 weeks; expedited delivery is not contractually guaranteed. Warranty is 60 months. A 3% rebate applies above 1,500 units.

title: Industrial Gateway Operations Manual
content: Gateways must be installed with restricted management access, time synchronization, centralized logging, and a documented recovery procedure. Firmware updates must be validated in a staging environment before production rollout. Operational teams should retain update evidence, rollback records, and incident timelines for auditability.

title: Project Orion Interface Specification — Revision A
content: Revision A requires two Gigabit Ethernet ports, Wi-Fi 6, a maximum enclosure depth of 120 mm, operating temperature of -20°C to +60°C, and a 36-month warranty. 5G connectivity is optional. Security updates are required for five years.

title: Project Orion Interface Specification — Revision B
content: Revision B requires two Gigabit Ethernet ports, Wi-Fi 6E or newer, a maximum enclosure depth of 115 mm, operating temperature of -20°C to +65°C, and a 48-month warranty. Integrated 5G connectivity is now mandatory. Security updates are required for seven years and remote attestation is preferred.

title: Supply Risk Assessment Framework
content: Supply risk should be assessed across technical fit, lead-time exposure, single-source dependency, cybersecurity evidence, commercial volatility, warranty/serviceability, and geopolitical or logistics concentration. A material gap in a mandatory requirement is a stop condition until resolved; preferred criteria can be traded off with documented rationale.

title: Sourcing Decision Governance Standard
content: A sourcing decision brief must distinguish mandatory requirements from preferences, cite source evidence, list unresolved assumptions, identify risk owners, and show commercial implications. The AI assistant may draft a decision brief, but a human category owner must approve the final recommendation before it is treated as an authorized sourcing decision.
